memories.text: Kestrel e-bike conversion: original battery vendor was VoltHive, 52V 17.5Ah pack.
Kestrel: switched battery vendor from VoltHive to AmpReach on March 3 because the AmpReach pack saves 12% weight at the same capacity.
Kestrel motor decision: Bafang G062 rear hub motor, chosen over the mid-drive for chainline simplicity.
Kestrel: first controller fried when it saw 52V on the battery side — replacement controller must be rated for 52V nominal.
Kestrel hard budget cap is $1,400 all-in, agreed at project start.
Kestrel range target: 45 miles per charge at assist level 2.
Kestrel frame has carbon dropouts, so a torque arm is mandatory before the hub motor goes in — carbon cannot take the axle torque.
Kestrel: brake levers need cutoff sensors wired to the controller, ordered the magnetic ring type.
Kestrel tires upgraded to Schwalbe Marathon Plus for puncture resistance under motor load.
Kestrel display unit is the DPC-18 color display, mounted left of the stem.
Kestrel: spoke gauge on the motor wheel build is 12G front-load pattern, built by the local shop.
Kestrel charger: 5A fast charger stays in the garage; the 2A travel charger lives in the pannier.
Aurora greenhouse controller runs on an ESP32-S3 dev board.
Aurora humidity/temperature sensing uses the SHT45 sensor on a 1-meter cable into the canopy.
Aurora irrigation uses DripWorks DV-2 solenoid drip valves, one per bed.
Aurora misting rule: misting triggers when canopy humidity drops below 38%.
Aurora: the tomatoes are in bed B2; peppers in B1; greens in B3.
Aurora firmware bug fixed: relay chatter on the mist pump was solved with a 500ms debounce on the humidity trigger.
Aurora power: 120W solar panel charging a 12V 20Ah LiFePO4 battery, controller is a Victron 75/10.
Aurora telemetry publishes MQTT to the house broker every 60 seconds, topic greenhouse/aurora.
Aurora enclosure is an IP65 box on the north post, glands pointed down after the first one leaked.
Aurora vent servo opens the ridge vent fully above 29C interior temperature.
Aurora: soil moisture probes were abandoned — too much drift; canopy humidity + drip timer is the design now.
Aurora watering window is 6:00-6:20am only, to avoid afternoon fungal pressure.
Tidehouse NAS case is the Jonsbo N3, eight bays, chosen for the small footprint.
Tidehouse drives: 4x 12TB Seagate Ironwolf, bought across two retailers to vary manufacturing batches.
Tidehouse filesystem is ZFS RAIDZ2 — two-drive failure tolerance was the requirement.
Tidehouse offsite backup target is Backblaze B2, encrypted with restic before upload.
Tidehouse ZFS scrub is scheduled weekly, Sunday 2am.
Tidehouse PSU is a Corsair SF450 — SFX form factor required by the Jonsbo case.
Tidehouse idle power measured at 31W at the wall with drives spun down.
Tidehouse motherboard: ITX board with 6 SATA ports plus an ASM1166 M.2 adapter for the extra bays.
Tidehouse RAM is 32GB ECC; ZFS ARC capped at 16GB in the boot config.
Tidehouse runs three services only: SMB shares, the photo library, and the restic backup timer. No VMs by design.
Tidehouse alerting: scrub and SMART failures email through the house relay; test email confirmed working April 12.
Tidehouse UPS is a 600VA line-interactive unit; NUT shuts the NAS down at 20% battery.
Falconer drone gimbal motors are GB2208 brushless gimbal motors, one per axis.
Falconer gimbal controller is the STorM32 board, firmware locked at version 2.61 — newer firmware broke the IMU filter settings.
Falconer camera is the Runcam Thumb Pro, chosen for weight.
Falconer vibration fix: printed TPU 95A dampers between the frame and gimbal cage killed the jello in footage.
Falconer balance: camera sits 2.3mm forward of the roll axis after the last rebalance — do not move the mount plate.
Falconer IMU is mounted under the camera plate, foam-taped, axis orientation +X forward.
Falconer power: gimbal runs off a 3S regulated rail at 11.5V, not battery-direct — voltage sag was causing motor hiccups.
Falconer pitch travel is software-limited to -90 to +30 degrees to keep the lens out of the props.
Falconer: PID autotune results were worse than manual; manual P values saved in the field notebook, page 14.
Falconer spare parts box has one spare GB2208 and two spare TPU damper sets, shelf C in the shop.
Marrow bakery: flour is Cairnspring Trailblazer, ordered in 50lb bags.
Marrow standard dough hydration is 78% for the country loaf.
Marrow bake day is Saturday; mix Friday evening, bake from 5am.
Marrow oven is a Rofco B40, three decks, 90-minute preheat.
Marrow pricing: $9 per loaf at the farmers market.
Marrow farmers market stall fee is $35 per Saturday.
Marrow sourdough starter is named Clyde, kept at 100% hydration, fed twice daily in summer.
Marrow cottage food license renewal is due August 15 — calendar reminder set for two weeks prior.
Marrow typical Saturday output is 36 loaves; sellout by 11am the last four markets.
Marrow: switched to parchment-lined transport crates after the cloth liners kept lint on the crust.
Marrow keeps a $200 float of small bills in the cash box for the market.
Preference: build documentation should use metric units.
Preference: status updates in bullet form, five bullets maximum.
Preference: avoid passive voice in anything written for others.
Context: home timezone is America/Denver.
Rule: any tool purchase over $200 needs sign-off from spouse before ordering.

tasks.prompt: Draft a short status update on the Kestrel battery situation — what changed and why.
Which motor did we pick for the Kestrel build, and what went wrong with the first controller?
Write next steps for Kestrel, keeping the agreed budget and range target in mind.
Remind me why the torque arm is non-negotiable on the Kestrel frame.
Status update on the Aurora misting logic — what sensor drives it and at what threshold?
What fixed the relay chatter problem on the Aurora mist pump?
Write a hardware recap for Aurora: the controller board, the drip valves, and the solar panel size.
Which bed are the tomatoes in, and what humidity level triggers misting in the greenhouse?
Summarize the Tidehouse storage design — case, drives, and filesystem layout.
When does the Tidehouse scrub run, and where do the offsite backups go?
Report the Tidehouse power story: PSU model and measured idle draw.
Draft a one-paragraph parts recap email for the Tidehouse build for a friend planning the same NAS.
Status on the Falconer vibration issue — what was the fix, and what motors are on the gimbal?
What firmware version is the Falconer gimbal locked at, and which controller board is it?
Describe the Falconer camera choice and the current balance offset.
Write a pre-flight tuning checklist for the Falconer gimbal mentioning the controller, dampers, and balance.
What do we charge per loaf at the market, and what does the stall cost us each week?
Status update on Marrow operations: the oven, the bake day, and our dough hydration.
What licensing deadline is coming up for Marrow?
Describe the flour we bake with and tell me about our starter.
